scope: Module-free packaging and boot audit; no runtime/kernel changes

gate.scope: Configured quick gate only; not full SPEC qualification

steps.name: module-free-boot
argv: capstone_vm.native_task=1 capstone_vm.native_io=1 capstone_vm.dom_binfmt=1 capstone_vm.native_dispatch=1 capstone_vm.checked_copy=1 capstone_vm.native_slot_transport=1 capstone_vm.unpinned=1 capstone_vm.supervisor_slots=1 capstone_vm.dom_shell=/tmp/native-shell/hush.dom capstone_vm.dom_null=1

steps.name: module-free-verdict
argv: from pathlib import Path; import sys; s=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(); assert "MODULE_FREE_PASS" in s and "MODULE_FREE_EXIT:0" in s; assert not any(x in s for x in ["Kernel panic", "Oops:", "FAIL:"]); print("PASS")

findings: No capstone_vm.ko* in root filesystem or staged resources.
No matching insmod/modprobe startup in /etc/init.d or /etc/inittab.
Obsolete external module/launcher build recipe replaced by explicit retirement error.
limitations: Existing rootfs already contained no Capstone module; no rootfs artifact was deleted or modified.
Historical module-based runners and archived platforms remain for old kernels.
Built-in Capstone adapter and exchange services remain; no complete Linux syscall compatibility claim.
No new application or full-SPEC qualification; same kernel as native-path qualification.
